mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_contact (merchant_id, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{contactName}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE contact_name = VALUES(contact_name), contact_email = VALUES(contact_email), contact_phone = VALUES(contact_phone), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
